age.evidence: Peripheral blood was collected from two male and seven female healthy individuals aged 20 to 43 years by standard venipuncture using a Vacuette Safety blood collection set with a 21G needle (Greiner Bio-one, Frickenhausen, Germany).
For experiments in Fig. 7d-e isolated EVs from cancer patients aged 35–83 years were used.
